extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent practitioners, attorneys/agents, and other filers before the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: Regulatory fee schedule and related procedural filing requirements for patent applications, post-allowance/issuance actions, document supply, petitions, expedited/prioritized processing, and reexamination before the USPTO. Includes entity-based fee tiers and fee-triggering events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension fees pursuant to § 1.136(a) (non-provisional except provisional-filed under § 1.53(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension fees for reply under § 1.136(a) for replies within first through fifth month (applies except in provisional applications filed under § 1.53(c)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First month: By a micro entity (§ 1.29) $47.00; by a small entity (§ 1.27(a)) $94.00; by other than a small or micro entity $235.00. Second month: micro $138.00; small $276.00; other $690.00. Third month: micro $318.00; small $636.00; other $1,590.00. Fourth month: micro $499.00; small $998.00; other $2,495.00. Fifth month: micro $679.00; small $1,358.00; other $3,395.00. (Tables 1–5 to paragraph (a).)

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees for filing a first request for continued examination (§ 1.114)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee for filing a first request for continued examination (RCE) in an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By a micro entity (§ 1.29) $318.00; by a small entity (§ 1.27(a)) $636.00; by other than a small or micro entity $1,590.00. (Table 8 to paragraph (e)(1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees for filing a second or subsequent request for continued examination (§ 1.114)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee for filing a second or subsequent RCE in an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By a micro entity (§ 1.29) $572.00; by a small entity (§ 1.27(a)) $1,144.00; by other than a small or micro entity $2,860.00. (Table 9 to paragraph (e)(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension fees in provisional applications filed under § 1.53(c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension fees pursuant to § 1.136(a) when the application is a provisional filed under § 1.53(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For replies within first through fifth month: (Table 26–30 to paragraph (u)) First month: micro $10.00; small $20.00; other $50.00. Second month: micro $20.00; small $40.00; other $100.00. Third month: micro $40.00; small $80.00; other $200.00. Fourth month: micro $80.00; small $160.00; other $400.00. Fifth month: micro $160.00; small $320.00; other $800.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees for filing a request for prioritized examination (§ 1.102(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee to file a request for prioritized examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Table 6 to paragraph (c) for entity-tiered amounts. (The rule lists a prioritized-examination request fee with amounts organized by micro, small, and other entity status.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition filing fees (various petition types referencing paragraph (f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for filing petitions that refer to paragraph (f) (various petition types listed by cross-reference).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 10 to paragraph (f): By a micro entity (§ 1.29) $90.00; by a small entity $180.00; by other than a small or micro entity $450.00. Note identifies numerous cross-referenced petition types (e.g., § 1.36(a) for revocation of power of attorney, § 1.53(e) to accord a filing date, § 1.182 decisions not specifically provided for, § 1.183 suspensions of rules in an application, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition filing fees (paragraph (g) and (g)(2) suspension requests)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for petitions that refer to paragraph (g), including first and subsequent requests for suspension pursuant to § 1.103(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 11 to paragraph (g)(1): By a micro entity $47.00; by a small entity $94.00; by other than a small or micro entity $235.00. Table 13 to paragraph (g)(2)(ii) (second or subsequent request for suspension): micro $90.00; small $180.00; other $450.00. (See note listing cross-referenced sections such as § 1.12, § 1.14, § 1.46, § 1.55(f), § 1.57(a), § 1.59, § 1.136(b), § 1.377, § 1.550(c), § 1.956 and § 5.12 of this chapter.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition filing fees referencing paragraph (h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for petitions that refer to paragraph (h) (various petitioner actions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 14 to paragraph (h): By a micro entity $30.00; by a small entity $60.00; by other than a small or micro entity $150.00. Note lists cross-referenced sections (e.g., § 1.84 accepting color drawings, § 1.91 entry of model or exhibit, § 1.102(d) to make application special, § 1.138(c) to expressly abandon to avoid publication, § 1.313 withdraw from issue, § 1.314 defer issuance of a patent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing fees for actions under specified sections (paragraph (i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Processing fees charged for taking action under listed sections referring to paragraph (i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 15 to paragraph (i)(1): By a micro entity $30.00 (example entry for actions referring to paragraph (i)(1)). Table 16 to paragraph (i)(2) lists a uniform $151.00 across micro, small, and other for certain actions. Note 4 & Note 5 list examples of cross-referenced sections (e.g., § 1.28(c)(3), § 1.29(k)(3), § 1.41(b), § 1.48, § 1.52(d), § 1.53(c)(3), §1.71(g), §1.102(e), §1.103(b)-(d), §1.291(c)(5), §3.81).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information disclosure statement (IDS) size fee (§ 1.97 / paragraph (v))
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional fee for an IDS filed under § 1.97 when applicant-provided or patent owner-provided items listed under § 1.98(a)(1) cause cumulative number of such items during pendency to exceed specified thresholds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If cumulative items exceed 50 but not exceed 100: $200.00. If exceed 100 but not exceed 200: $500.00 less any amounts previously paid under paragraph (v)(1). If exceed 200: $800.00 less any amounts previously paid under paragraph (v)(1) and/or (2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional fee for presenting a benefit claim (35 U.S.C. 120/121/365(c)/386(c) and § 1.78(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional fee when a benefit claim is presented in a nonprovisional application and the actual filing date is more than specified years from the earliest filing date for which benefit is claimed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When actual filing date is more than six years and no more than nine years from earliest filing date: Table 31 — micro $540.00; small $1,080.00; other $2,700.00. When actual filing date is more than nine years: Table 32 — micro $800.00; small $1,600.00; other $4,000.00 (less any amounts previously paid under paragraph (w)(1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue fee for issuing each original patent (non-design/plant/reissue) (§ 1.18(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue fee for issuing each original patent (except design or plant) or each reissue patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 1 to paragraph (a): By a micro entity (§ 1.29) $258.00; by a small entity (§ 1.27(a)) $516.00; by other than a small or micro entity $1,290.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue fee for issuing an original design patent (§ 1.18(b)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue fee for an original design patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 2 to paragraph (b)(1): By a micro entity $260.00; by a small entity $520.00; by other than a small or micro entity $1,300.00. (Also provides alternative Hague Agreement payment route for international design applications designating the U.S.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue fee for issuing an original plant patent (§ 1.18(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue fee for an original plant patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 3 to paragraph (c): By a micro entity $181.00; by a small entity $362.00; by other than a small or micro entity $905.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and republication fees (§ 1.18(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication fees tied to date of publication and republication fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication fee on or after January 1, 2014: $0.00. Publication fee before January 1, 2014: $320.00. Republication fee (§ 1.221(a)): $344.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent term adjustment and reinstatement filing fees (§ 1.18(e)-(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for filing an application for patent term adjustment and for filing a request for reinstatement of all or part of a reduced term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For filing an application for patent term adjustment under § 1.705: $226.00. For filing a request for reinstatement under § 1.705 (reduced term) : $452.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document supply: uncertified printed copy of application publication or patent (paper portion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee for an uncertified printed copy (paper portion) of a patent application publication or patent (includes designs, statutory invention registrations, defensive publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service includes preparation and delivery timelines; fee: $3.00. (Paper copies black-and-white unless original is color or color requested and paid.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Document supply: color and other copy fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for color copies and printed copies of plant patents in color, and other copy types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Printed copy of a plant patent in color: $16.00. Color copy of a patent (other than plant) or statutory invention registration containing a color drawing: $25.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document supply: copies of application/file wrapper and individual documents (paper or electronic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for copies of an application as filed, patent file wrapper, individual documents, and electronic media copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If provided on paper: Application as filed $38.00; Copy Patent File Wrapper, Paper, Any Number of Sheets $312.00; individual application documents (other than application as filed), per document $27.00. If provided on compact disc or other physical electronic medium or electronically: Application as filed $38.00; Copy Patent File Wrapper, Electronic, Any Medium, Any Size $65.00. Copy Office records (except those available under paragraph (b)(1) or (2)): $27.00. Assignment records abstract and certification, per patent: $38.00. Uncertified copy of a non-U.S. patent document, per document: $27.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document supply: library service and subscription products
rubrics_metrics.description: Recurring fees for library services and subscription access to patent image/text feeds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library service (35 U.S.C. 13) providing copies of all patents issued annually per annum: $50.00. Copy of Patent Grant Single-Page TIFF Images (52 week subscription): $10,400.00. Copy of Patent Grant Full-Text W/Embedded Images, Patent Application Publication Single-Page TIFF Images, or Patent Application Publication Full-Text W/Embedded Images (52 week subscription): $5,200.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-issuance fees: certificate of correction and correcting inventorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for providing certificate of correction for applicant’s mistake and processing fee for correcting inventorship in a patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certificate of correction (§ 1.323): $172.00. Processing fee for correcting inventorship in a patent (§ 1.324): $172.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reexamination filing fees and formatting requirements (ex parte reexamination) (§ 1.20(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees for filing requests for ex parte reexamination and related reexamination fees, with explicit document formatting requirements for certain fee tiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For an ex parte reexamination request having 40 or fewer pages, double-spaced or 1.5 spaced lines, non-script font (e.g., Arial, Times New Roman, Courier), sufficient contrast and clarity to permit OCR, and otherwise complying with paragraph (c)(1): Table 1 to paragraph (c)(1)(i) — By a micro entity $1,355.00; by a small entity $2,710.00; by other than a small or micro entity $6,775.00. For requests meeting an alternate listed set of requirements (Table 2 to paragraph (c)(2)) the amounts shown include: micro $2,709.00; small $5,418.00; other $13,545.00. For filing a request with sufficient clarity (Table with smaller amounts): micro $120.00; small $240.00; other $600.00. For each claim in excess of 20 (and in excess of number of claims in the patent under reexamination): Table 4 to paragraph (c)(4): by a micro entity $40.00; by a small entity $80.00; (other-entity amount in table). Note: specified portions of ex parte reexamination requests are excluded from certain formatting provisions (e.g., copies of patents and printed publications relied upon, copy of entire patent, required certifications). Also font size, margins (§ 1.52(a)(1)(ii)), and clarity/contrast requirements are listed (e.g., font size no smaller than 12 point).
